name: relation_paged_160k_temi_v13
status: completed native MP-SPDZ Temi execution with exact reconstruction
scope_warning: One favorable degree-one synthetic query, three parties on one localhost, preprocessing included. This does not instantiate physical server separation, measure WAN latency, establish general MetaQA/WebQSP scalability, make the linear lookup sublinear, or provide malicious security.

protocol.name: MP-SPDZ Temi
protocol.security: semi-honest dishonest majority, exactly three parties, up to two passive corruptions
protocol.preprocessing: LWE-based semi-homomorphic encryption adaptation of CDN01 with diagonal packing
protocol.field_requirement: prime is 1 modulo 32768; all graph and query shares were regenerated under this field
protocol.default_unchanged: Semi remains the repository default; Temi is an explicitly selected execution backend

layout.kind: dense relation-paged with folded hop-two relation

one_time_global_frontier_gate.opened_semantics: number of keys exceeding global_frontier; no key identity or per-key count
one_time_global_frontier_gate.optimization: SIMD Horner evaluation of the exact bounded-domain overflow polynomial; no bit decomposition
one_time_global_frontier_gate.assumption: owner inputs obey their preparation-enforced occupancy range, as required by the passive external-input model

execution.compiler_scale_note: More than 9.8 million reported lines; roughly twelve minutes. Temi changes preprocessing/execution, not circuit-generation scale.

comparison_same_160k_fixture.comparability_caveat: All retrieval arms use the same graph/query semantics and favorable verified global frontier where applicable, but Temi uses a different compatible field and preprocessing protocol. All shares were freshly generated and outputs independently checked.

claim_boundary: This is a protocol-backend and systems integration result, not a new cryptographic primitive. The strongest claim is exact dependent two-hop federated KG retrieval under a passive two-of-three corruption threshold with a KG-aware linear oblivious layout and HE-backed preprocessing.
